fact: TIFF/LAZ never go to a product route here, regardless of size. Browser lists, not retains them.
Shown: Document or table, Not imported, GIS layers are read now. CSV and XLSX can be imported as
tables; other files need a case upload. Alone: Blocked: add a GIS file (GeoJSON, GeoPackage or a
zipped shapefile). With vectors, only first ready GIS is product-imported; non-GIS files stay local.
DEV or VITE_HOSTED_DEMO=1 AND VITE_DEMO_IMPORT=1 admits TIFF/LAZ for demo inspection only.
POST /api/demo/inspect then /api/demo/imports; whole FormData32MiB, ZIP expanded64MiB, exact NYC
hash only. Unknown TIFF/LAZ fails with '<name> is not one of the verified NYC profile files. No
generic or AI normalization is enabled in demo mode.' No product fallback for these extensions.
Start requires at least one prepared GeoJSON layer to establish the map; originals go to demo disk.
POST .../uploads admits only >16MiB: v1<=128MiB, v2<=7GiB opt-in, zip or octet-stream.
It stores large-original-v1, not geotiff-raster-v1/laz-point-v1: native authority denies even after
a successful large receipt. v1:8MiB parts,16 parts,active case/operator2 global4,128 lifetime
receipts,512MiB reserved originals/1GiB copies; v2:896 parts,active1,8 lifetime receipts,7GiB
reserved originals/22GiB display ceiling. Case/source/operator/access and SHA remain required.
Part/storage deadlines30/30s v1,30/60s v2;180s lease,3 part/finalize attempts; finalize120s/12h.
Separate POST .../rasters or .../points retains original with caller-declared lineage and queues
one first native part,201. These routes do not register an intake item or probe it.
POST .../intake/items separately enrols retained bytes and probes ranges; sourceId=itemId.
S<=16MiB,M<=128MiB,L<=7GiB; raster/point wave2. No reader unless vector draft guard admits it.
Probe64KiB head+64KiB tail,2s absolute deadline; first classic TIFF IFD only if inside head.
width/height/bands are scalar tags, tiled=true iff322/324 present; false means absent in parsed IFD.
GeoKey34735 makes geotiff; inline EPSG2048/3072 is stated, multiple same-kind codes conflicting.
No transform, dtype, nodata, overview or extent calculation. BigTIFF remains signature depth.
Local configured subject, active case, exact geotiff-raster-v1 receipt and latest source required.
No named officer-role decorator. PrivateSpatialGuard rejects cross-site, not a role check.
retain automatically queues null-window first part; explicit POST .../sources/:id/raster-windows
queues exactly one selected window. requestKey replay precedes enqueue caps; request pins current
case/source/hash, job pins source/context/reader/access with compareSourcePins, not strict counter.
Worker POSTs internal/raster/window to token-protected geo processor; Python S3 GETs unchanged
original, spools entire file and hashes it for EACH window. rasterio reads only selected values
and masks; default(0,0,min256width,min256height). Writes deflated native GeoTIFF, not PNG/tile.
JSON holds source/window affine, CRS/WKT, resolution, window native bounds, dtype/nodata/mask
counts for1-4 bands, vertical reference status, globalPlacement=not_qualified and artifact hash.
Dispatcher's12 oldest runnable jobs starts worker; one raster worker Promise per process.
Fenced jobs/usp_job_metadata/usp_job_attempts hold pins and accepted result_ref; JSON and .tif
live under raster-windows/:jobId/:sha. No raster-window row table, no usp_intake_parts row.
Completed transaction emits raster-window.changed and canonical job acceptance, not pixels.
Source inspection/status and holdings card are not updated by the worker; no next-window caller.
Local configured subject, active case, exact laz-point-v1 receipt and latest source required.
POST .../points queues null-batch first8192; POST .../sources/:id/point-batches queues one selection.
Current request pins case/source/hash; job source/context/reader/access compare ignores counter advance.
Token-protected POST internal/point/batch. Each call S3 GETs, hashes and spools ENTIRE original.
laspy opens compressed LAS1.4 format6 only, record length30, no extras; seek(start),read_points(count).
Artifact is exact little-endian native records, not JSON XYZ, tiles, COPC nodes or surface grid.
Receipt has point count, scales/offsets, XYZ bounds, horizontal/vertical CRS, GPS time type,
field offsets/dtypes, selected range, globalPlacement=not_qualified; no computed height.
Same job authority and accepted-attempt fence; one point worker Promise per process.
SQL jobs/usp_job_metadata/usp_job_attempts only; point-batches/:jobId/:sha.json and .bin in storage.
point-batch.changed event on completion, no point data, no intake part/card update or continuation.
Product GET .../sources/:sourceId/raster-windows/jobs/:jobId gives metadata; /artifact gives
private native TIFF only for current succeeded exact accepted attempt/hash. Studio calls neither.
NYC context supplementalDatasets comes from demo Python, after its whole-file fusion finishes.
Ortho bytes read by browser at /api/v1/sources/:demoSourceId/file (intercepted by demo plugin).
imagery.worker decodes full first image. Requires3/4 bands,GeoKey3857,<=16M pixels; area must
have origin and WGS84 UTM analysis CRS, and dataset geographic bbox. DEM layer has no branch.
This is an application URL but NOT the retained raster-window authority or a dropped file blob URL.

fact: Demo reads all LAZ in250000-point chunks; maximum Z per2m cell excludes withheld/classes7/18,
<=1M cells, no hole fill; writes lidar-observed-surface.tif; GET /api/demo/areas/:id/surface.
Browser reads entire first TIFF,<=16M pixels; samples band0, keeps finite non-nodata cells.
Subtracts originXY, subtracts2nd percentile Z for approximate display, colours2nd..98th percentile.
Requires same UTM zone/hemisphere, GeoKey matches d.crs, same area CRS OR specific6347->32618
exception; no qualified transform is performed for that exception. User switches LiDAR on.
Card save does not set placement: default undecided. No surface holding extent/key/part is written.
Absent/conflicting CRS does NOT become needs_answer here. Probe's drawableHint stays false.
Jobs pin case frame/context/siteId hash but never compare extent to an area's reference or link
to its anchors. Adding files advances counter safely; binding an unassigned case to a site changes
context hash and stales these jobs even if frame/revision unchanged. HTTP run had no anchor binding.

models.title: OBJ, read only
fact: Dropped .obj stays Document or table/Not imported (same drop guard); sources format refuses;
uploads retains >16MiB opaque but objSourceTx requires obj-native-v1. Dedicated POST .../obj keeps
<=16MiB and queues obj-native. Worker needs pinned objConfig/assertObjTools; missing tools retains
bytes but fails OBJ_UNAVAILABLE (obj-config.ts:80-85). Python inventories UTF8 v/vt/vn, faces and
declarations with exact byte/line locators, materials/companions unresolved; local context mesh only.
GET .../sources/:id/obj/jobs/:jobId/native returns JSON, not a rendered model; Studio consumes none.
Axes,units,CRS,height reference/global placement unknown; no area transform, officer-placement UI or
registry admission (obj-processor.ts:22-25,43-47). Even a georeference comment is not a placement.

No Studio model drawing or batch placement; rendering=false/globalPlacement=unknown, no measured
